The section does not report any study identifiers (e.g., 'Study 1'), sample characteristics, BMI assessment, correlations with BMI, or other methodological details.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Participants were asked to complete an Arabic-translated version of the BAS-2,3 a 10-item scale... Items are rated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (Never) to 5 (Always), and an overall score computed as the mean of the 10 items... The BAS-2 has shown satisfactory reliability and validity in samples from a range of diverse socio-cultural contexts."
